title: Rate Record
governance_note: Rate convention must be documented before comparing financial outcomes.

title: Cash-Flow Record
governance_note: Cash-flow timing can dominate financial conclusions.

title: Compounding Record
governance_note: Compounding convention should match contract terms or model purpose.

title: Discount Record
governance_note: Discount-rate choices can dominate long-horizon conclusions.

title: Debt Record
governance_note: Debt may grow if payment does not exceed interest accumulation.

title: Risk Record
governance_note: Expected return does not guarantee realized compounded outcome.

title: Claim Boundary
governance_note: Financial conclusions should not exceed rate conventions, cash-flow evidence, risk assumptions, uncertainty, and tested scope.
